cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when I taught you to distract Mum with a question? Keep her in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time I asked about pastry, she made me bake a pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you held her attention. This time ask a question you can survive the answer to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want to show me either way. You can peel the apples.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally negotiating before you agree. I'll peel; you get her teaching. Quietly, or she'll discover where you learned that trick.
